properties.displayName: FW-011 Firewall - Outbound connection allowed to a restricted country
properties.description: Detects internal hosts making outbound connections to public IPs in a restricted country that the firewall allowed. Outbound traffic to countries the organisation has no business with can indicate malware command-and-control, data exfiltration or policy violations.
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
// EXAMPLE list only. Replace with your organisation's or customer's restricted-country policy.
// Add every spelling your data uses (run the country check in docs/data-sources.md).
let RestrictedCountries = dynamic([
    "North Korea", "Korea, Democratic People's Republic of",
    "Iran", "Iran, Islamic Republic of",
    "Syria", "Syrian Arab Republic",
    "Cuba"
]);
// FortiGate logs allowed sessions as accept/close/timeout/*-rst; Palo Alto uses allow
let AllowedActions = dynamic(["accept", "allow", "close", "timeout", "server-rst", "client-rst"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP))
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in (AllowedActions)
| extend DestinationCountry = coalesce(
    extract(@"FTNTFGTdstcountry=([^;]+)", 1, AdditionalExtensions),
    tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(DestinationIP).country))
| where DestinationCountry in~ (RestrictedCountries)
| summarize
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),
    SessionCount = count(),
    DestinationIPs = make_set(DestinationIP, 25),
    DestinationPorts = make_set(DestinationPort, 25),
    BytesSent = sum(SentBytes),
    BytesReceived = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    FirewallName = take_any(DeviceName)
    by SourceIP, DestinationCountry, DeviceVendor
| project StartTime, EndTime, SourceIP, DestinationCountry, SessionCount, DestinationIPs, DestinationPorts, BytesSent, BytesReceived, DeviceVendor, FirewallName

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: The firewall allowed {{SessionCount}} outbound session(s) from {{SourceIP}} to restricted country {{DestinationCountry}}.
